The '''Theed Crest''' was a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Force]] medal awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who succeeded in rescuing [[Karl Eckener]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Theed Crest appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
